newsitem.title: ITALY: One dead in helicopter crash on NATO sea exercise.
newsitem.headline: One dead in helicopter crash on NATO sea exercise.

text.p: A serviceman was killed and four others were injured on Sunday when an Italian helicopter crashed at sea during NATO military manoeuvres, the alliance's southern command said.

A spokesman, U.S. Major Tom Larock, said the accident happened about 60 miles east of Gibraltar in the Mediterranean as the helicopter was performing ship-to-ship transfers from the Greek frigate Limnos to a British destroyer, the Birmingham.
The helicopter, from the Italian frigate Scirocco, "went down while making the final approach to the Birmingham", Larock said.

Military sources identified the victim as Italian and said three Italians and a Briton were injured. The survivors and the victim were recovered in a search and rescue mission launched from the Birmingham.
"The survivors were taken to the Birmingham for initial medical care and then transferred to medical facilities in Gibraltar," Larock said.
He had no further details of how the crash occurred or the condition of the survivors. The cause of the accident was under investigation, Larock said.
